    MARINE COLLAGEN

    • WHAT IS COLLAGEN?

      Collagen is the most abundant protein in the human body, making up around 30% of its total protein. It is an important component of our skin, bones, muscles, ligaments and other tissues. There are several types of collagen in the body, each helping to support different tissues and structures.

      Supplemental collagen is commonly sourced from fish as marine collagen or from cattle as bovine collagen, with some products also using chicken- or egg-derived collagen.

      Derived from animal sources, vegan collagen is not possible, although plant-based collagen alternatives are available and designed to support the body's natural collagen production.

    • WHY IS COLLAGEN IMPORTANT?

      Our bodies produce collagen naturally, but this process becomes less efficient as we age. Reducing about 1.5% every year from our mid-twenties onwards, this leads to visible signs of ageing and loss of radiance in our skin.

      These decreases can affect skin firmness and elasticity. Women tend to experience a more rapid decrease in collagen density compared to men. Hormonal changes, particularly during and after menopause, can also influence collagen levels in women.

      However, after 25, collagen production declines in both sexes; hair and nails become weaker, whilst our joints become stiffer, and we heal less quickly from injuries.

    • WHAT'S THE SCIENCE OF COLLAGEN?

      In the human body, as in the rest of nature, collagen exists as a long chain triple helix which cannot be absorbed without being broken down. This breakdown process is normally undertaken by the action of the stomach which breaks collagen into its constituent amino acids which can then be absorbed in the small intestine. Unfortunately, this action also destroys the nature of the collagen.

    • WHAT'S INGENIOUS COLLAGEN?

      Most collagen supplements contain hydrolysed collagen, also known as collagen peptides. This means the collagen has been broken down into smaller chains of amino acids, making it easier for the body to digest.

      However, the way collagen is delivered also matters. Ingenious uses a patented, plant-based capsule designed to protect its marine collagen peptides as they pass through the stomach.

      Unlike standard collagen powders or liquids, our capsules are designed to remain intact until they reach the small intestine. A change in pH then triggers the capsule to dissolve, releasing its contents where nutrients can be absorbed.

      Each recommended dose delivers 627mg of hydrolysed marine collagen. We use peptides weighing 2,000 Daltons or less, compared with a stated industry average of 5,000 Daltons. Their smaller molecular size is intended to support efficient digestion and absorption.

      Our carefully measured collagen dose also leaves room for other active ingredients. We don't use unnecessary preservatives, artificial flavours or fillers.

      Both Collagen+ and Active contain responsibly sourced marine collagen peptides from the skin of free-swimming freshwater fish. Combined with our patented capsule technology, this forms the basis of the Ingenious approach to collagen supplementation.

    HYALURONIC ACID COMPLEX

    • WHAT IS HYALURONIC ACID?

      Hyaluronic Acid, also known as Hyaluron or HA is a gentle yet powerful, moisture-binding substance that occurs naturally in your body. It’s present in our skin, our inner connective tissue, between our joints and in our eyes. Its main purpose is to retain water, to keep everything well lubricated and maintain structural integrity.

    • WHY IS HYALURONIC ACID IMPORTANT?

      HA exists naturally in almost every cell in the body. If you have sufficient HA in your body, your skin will feel soft and beautifully moisturised and the resulting elasticity will help protect against wrinkles forming. Your joints and body are more likely to feel supple and you should be able to bend and stretch with ease. However, HA has a half-life (the time it takes for the molecule to get broken down and excreted from the body) of less than 3 days in the body and as little as one day in the skin. For this reason, it is imperative that the body continually replenish itself with HA. Unfortunately, as we age, we lose the ability to replace HA at the rate required which in part explains why age-related symptoms appear, our skin becomes drier and less elastic, and wrinkles start to form.

      Fortunately, supplementing with Ingenious' superior HA can help resolve this loss.

    • WHAT'S THE SCIENCE OF HYALURONIC ACID?

      Just one molecule of hyaluronic acid can bind 1,000 times its own weight in water, bringing superior strength and firmness to your skin.

      As we age and our HA lubrication levels drop, the space between bones in our joints can reduce, leading to joint stiffness, aches and pain. Taking a HA supplement has been shown to help with joint health.

      Hyaluronic Acid also plays a vital part in wound healing. It works by aiding the regulation of inflammation levels as well as sending signals to the body to construct more blood vessels in the wounded area.

      HA is thought to help with chronic eye dryness which affects about 1 in 7 older adults. Contact lenses with slowly releasing HA are being developed. As HA is naturally present as a lubricant in the eye, having healthy levels are believed to be important in this area.

    • WHAT'S INGENIOUS HYALURONIC ACID?

      The profile of Ingenious’ hyaluronic acid is specifically designed for targeted results. It’s 20% more effective at keeping skin and tissue hydrated and plump than industry standard.

      The hyaluronan used by Ingenious is a pioneering finely modulated Full Spectrum Hyaluronan Complex, able to deeply integrate into the biology of targeted tissues, matching skin, joints, muscle and other needs. All to maximise efficiency and work exactly where you need it.  

      The HA found in most supplements and creams consists of only one length of HA molecule. The Ingenious Hyaluronan Complex mimics the physiology of your body’s HA. 

    Natural Astaxanthin

    • WHAT IS ASTAXANTHIN?

      Astaxanthin is one of the most powerful antioxidants ever discovered and belongs to the carotenoid group of molecules. It is an incredible 6,000 times stronger than the better known antioxidant vitamin C.

      As a powerful antioxidant, Astaxanthin has been shown to have many benefits when taken as a supplement; from skin repair, reducing wrinkles, repairing joints, eye health and even aiding the brain.

      The benefits of astaxanthin are vast and astounding, that’s why we use it as a core ingredient in all of our supplements. For more information on the potential benefits of astaxanthin, read our blog ‘Amazing Astaxanthin’.

      Astaxanthin is the main carotenoid pigment found in pink aquatic animals like salmon, and birds such as flamingos who feed upon the natural microalgae that produces astaxanthin. While this gives those animals their pink colouring, humans will not turn pink as a result of taking supplements containing astaxanthin.

    • WHY IS ASTAXANTHIN IMPORTANT?

      Modern lifestyles put our bodies under attack from free radicals produced by UV rays, pollution, stress, smoking and poor nutrition. The damage caused by free radicals is a major cause of skin ageing which affects all layers of the skin, from the visible surface to the delicate deep layers where new skin is formed, destroying both collagen and hyaluronic acid.

      Astaxanthin breaks down Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS), or ‘free radicals’ that directly damage collagen fibres. By harnessing the ROS reducing properties of natural astaxanthin, we aid the reduction in damage to both existing and new collagen and the fibroblasts that produce it.

    • WHAT'S THE SCIENCE OF NATURAL ASTAXANTHIN?

      A clinical trial undertaken on natural astaxanthin (the ingredient used in Ingenious formulation) revealed that taking 4mg of astaxanthin significantly reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, skin roughness and skin redness after six weeks.

      Further clinical studies also reveal how taking supplemental astaxanthin every day can help to improve eyesight, protects against types of ocular degeneration and help combat screen-induced eye fatigue. You can find more information about this topic in our blog post ‘Astaxanthin and Healthy Vision’.

      Astaxanthin has been shown to exert a strong protective effect on the brain and has also been used to help treat and prevent diseases such as Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s. The human central nervous system (CNS) contains 100 billion neuronal cells and is vulnerable to oxidative stress and inflammation due to its low cellular renewal rate. Extensive studies have found that carotenoids such as astaxanthin, with its ability to lower rates of inflammation as well as fighting free radicals, can help to protect and preserve the central nervous system and enhance brain function.

    • WHAT'S INGENIOUS NATURAL ASTAXANTHIN?

      The natural astaxanthin used in Ingenious products​ is derived from a micro-algae sustainably sourced from a Swedish archipelago. The process to extract this astaxanthin operates in a carbon negative closed circuit system, with the thermal energy produced heating a local town outside of Stockholm, Sweden.

    Choose Collagen+ if your priority is visible skin change. Choose Active if you train and want recovery support too.

    Still not sure? Take the Collagen Test.
    Why only 627mg when other brands have 10,000mg?

    Because dose isn't the point. Absorption is. Most collagen products are broken down in your stomach before your body can use them.

    A bigger unprotected dose is still unprotected.

    Collagen+ uses a patented capsule that protects 627mg and delivers it intact to your small intestine, where 99% of absorption happens.
    When will I see results?

    The trial measured the full result at 12 weeks. By week 12, 98% of women saw real improvement in at least one measurement.

    This is why we recommend the 90-day plan. It matches the trial exactly.
    Is it safe with my other supplements or medications?

    Yes. All ingredients are Generally Recognised As Safe (GRAS).

    No known side effects or interactions.

    If you're on prescription medication or pregnant, speak to your GP.
    What fish is used, and is it tested for heavy metals?

    Our marine collagen is sourced from free-swimming tilapia. Every batch is rigorously tested for heavy metals to ensure it meets our strict quality and safety standards.
    Am I too old? Is it too late?

    No. The trial included women aged 30 to 60. Every age band saw real change.

    Largest single-cohort wrinkle reduction was in the 30–40 group — but women in the 51–60 group also saw significant change. After 25 your body produces less collagen each year.

    In menopause it can drop by 30%. The earlier you start, the better — but it's never too late.
